providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): Voyager 2 imaged only one hemisphere of Proteus at usable resolution during its single 1989 flyby; no controlled global mosaic was ever produced. Procedural texture parameterized on the real Pharos crater (~250 km, over half of Proteus's own diameter, with a central dome) — one oversized basin with a central peak, plus dense general cratering, same treatment as Mimas/Herschel above.
